links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT answers to scoliosis FAQs, plus accuracy and clarity ratings
links.effect: Reading level required ranged from 11th grade to college graduate. Mika et al. accuracy averaged 2.4 (satisfactory, needing minimal to moderate clarification). Mean DISCERN score was 45.9.
links.quote: When prompted with 12 scoliosis FAQs, ChatGPT produces responses of satisfactory accuracy but require further clarification and are written at an inappropriately high reading level for the scoliosis patient population.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy, quality, and readability on pediatric orthopaedic FAQs regarding scoliosis without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
